ambiguity.detail: The flash-forward opening drops the viewer into a confrontation with zero context on what just hurt the character.

verdict.hook_line: There. Finally. Something still hurts you.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: Corrupt aristocrats finalize a sinister plan to turn a prisoner into a condemned witch through a rigged trial.
verdict.why_it_works: The flash-forward hook followed by pure villainous escalation leaves the viewer desperate for the hero's survival.
